name: App
description: The user's kept lists (shopping, packing, to-dos), as small apps: one call makes one, adds, ticks off or removes items, and the reply has a Card line showing the list live in the chat, which opens a page where the user ticks items too. Use it for any list the user keeps, never a hand-written page. Lists are per workspace: list them before making one. Ask before delete.
author: anything

examples.prompt: Put oat milk on the groceries list
Start a packing list for the trip: passport, charger, rain jacket

action.description: create, do (one op), show, list (this workspace's apps) or delete.

name.description: The app's name: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. 'groceries'.

title.description: Its title, for create or op rename.

op.description: For do: add, check, uncheck, remove, clear_done or rename.

item.description: The item, as text, for add, check, uncheck or remove.

items.description: Several items to add (create or add), as a list of text.
